final: WITH group_avgs AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.PLT) AS avg_plt FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_plt) AS avg_plt FROM group_avgs), differences AS (SELECT g.ID, g.SEX, g.avg_plt, g.avg_plt - o.avg_plt AS diff FROM group_avgs AS g JOIN overall_avg AS o ON o.avg_plt IS NOT NULL), sex_avgs AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM differences GROUP BY SEX), retained AS (SELECT d.avg_plt, d.diff, d.diff - s.avg_diff AS excess_diff FROM differences AS d JOIN sex_avgs AS s ON d.SEX = s.SEX WHERE d.diff > s.avg_diff) SELECT AVG(avg_plt) AS average_group_platelet_count, AVG(diff) AS average_difference_from_overall, AVG(excess_diff) AS average_difference_above_sex_average FROM retained
